mapper.select: SELECT i.total_issues, i.open_issues, d.daily_plan_count, u.unallocated_count, u.pending_unallocated, p.pool_count, p.total_available, p.total_allocated FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) total_issues, COALESCE(SUM(status='OPEN'),0) open_issues FROM mrp_decision_issue WHERE batch_id=#{batchId}) i CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) daily_plan_count FROM mrp_daily_plan_detail WHERE run_id=#{runId}) d CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) unallocated_count, COALESCE(SUM(status='PENDING'),0) pending_unallocated FROM mrp_unallocated_quantity WHERE run_id=#{runId}) u CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) pool_count, COALESCE(SUM(available_qty),0) total_available, COALESCE(SUM(allocated_qty),0) total_allocated FROM mrp_inventory_pool WHERE batch_id=#{batchId}) p
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrp_calc_batch (factory_code, status, forecast_version_id, inventory_snapshot_id, inventory_snapshot_group_id, bom_snapshot_id, bom_source_checksum, category_role_version_id, material_policy_version_id, production_calendar_version_id, factory_warehouse_mapping_version_id, stock_policy_version_id, business_week_version_id, decision_checksum, rule_version, input_checksum, result_checksum, version_no, active_run_id, published_at, active_request_key, revision_of_batch_id, revision_no, superseded_by_batch_id, issue_count, unresolved_count, version, created_by) VALUES (#{factoryCode}, #{status}, #{forecastVersionId}, #{inventorySnapshotId}, #{inventorySnapshotGroupId}, #{bomSnapshotId}, #{bomSourceChecksum}, #{categoryRoleVersionId}, #{materialPolicyVersionId}, #{productionCalendarVersionId}, #{factoryWarehouseMappingVersionId}, #{stockPolicyVersionId}, #{businessWeekVersionId}, #{decisionChecksum}, #{ruleVersion}, #{inputChecksum}, #{resultChecksum}, #{versionNo}, #{activeRunId}, #{publishedAt}, #{activeRequestKey}, #{revisionOfBatchId}, #{revisionNo}, #{supersededByBatchId}, #{issueCount}, #{unresolvedCount}, #{version}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE mrp_calc_batch SET status=#{status}, forecast_version_id=#{forecastVersionId}, inventory_snapshot_id=#{inventorySnapshotId}, inventory_snapshot_group_id=#{inventorySnapshotGroupId}, bom_snapshot_id=#{bomSnapshotId}, bom_source_checksum=#{bomSourceChecksum}, category_role_version_id=#{categoryRoleVersionId}, material_policy_version_id=#{materialPolicyVersionId}, production_calendar_version_id=#{productionCalendarVersionId}, factory_warehouse_mapping_version_id=#{factoryWarehouseMappingVersionId}, stock_policy_version_id=#{stockPolicyVersionId}, business_week_version_id=#{businessWeekVersionId}, decision_checksum=#{decisionChecksum}, rule_version=#{ruleVersion}, input_checksum=#{inputChecksum}, result_checksum=#{resultChecksum}, version_no=#{versionNo}, active_run_id=#{activeRunId}, published_at=#{publishedAt}, active_request_key=#{activeRequestKey}, revision_of_batch_id=#{revisionOfBatchId}, revision_no=#{revisionNo}, superseded_by_batch_id=#{supersededByBatchId}, issue_count=#{issueCount}, unresolved_count=#{unresolvedCount}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mrp_calc_batch WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM mrp_calc_batch WHERE status=#{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM mrp_calc_batch ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT b.* FROM mrp_calc_batch b WHERE b.status NOT IN ('SUPERSEDED', 'CANCELLED', 'FAILED', 'STALE') ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE mrp_calc_batch SET status=#{status}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
UPDATE mrp_calc_batch SET status=#{status}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status<>'STALE'
UPDATE mrp_calc_batch SET active_run_id=#{runId}, status=#{status}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status<>'STALE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrp_batch_factory_scope (batch_id, factory_code, warehouse_code, production_calendar_version_id, inventory_snapshot_id) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{factoryCode}, #{warehouseCode}, #{productionCalendarVersionId}, #{inventorySnapshotId})
INSERT INTO mrp_batch_business_week_scope(batch_id, business_month, business_week_version_id) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{businessMonth}, #{businessWeekVersionId})
mapper.select: SELECT business_month FROM mrp_batch_business_week_scope WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY business_month
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrp_batch_factory_scope (batch_id, factory_code, warehouse_code, production_calendar_version_id, inventory_snapshot_id) SELECT #{targetBatchId}, factory_code, warehouse_code, production_calendar_version_id, inventory_snapshot_id FROM mrp_batch_factory_scope WHERE batch_id=#{sourceBatchId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.factory_code AS factoryCode, s.warehouse_code AS warehouseCode, COALESCE(d.warehouse_name, s.warehouse_code) AS warehouseName, d.is_good_warehouse AS goodWarehouse, d.priority_no AS priorityNo, d.maintenance_order AS maintenanceOrder FROM mrp_batch_factory_scope s LEFT JOIN mrp_calc_batch b ON b.id = s.batch_id LEFT JOIN factory_warehouse_mapping_detail d ON d.version_id = b.factory_warehouse_mapping_version_id AND d.factory_code = s.factory_code AND d.warehouse_code = s.warehouse_code AND d.enabled = 1 WHERE s.batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY s.id
SELECT factory_code FROM mrp_batch_factory_scope WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} GROUP BY factory_code ORDER BY MIN(id)
